notes: Bootstrap entry. SHA reflects the hardware/jetson-full-smoke branch HEAD that built the currently-deployed image on the rover at /opt/mousedroid. Update this file (in the same PR or immediately after) whenever the Jetson image is rebuilt and pushed. The CI schema-compat gate (scripts/check_config_compat.py) loads changed config YAMLs against THIS sha's Settings schema to detect when a config change requires an image rebuild before deploy.
